transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. ...Well, my husband insisted I come in. It's mostly just... a situation with our house. For nearly two years now, I've been sure that the contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me all these receipts, and they give us endless excuses, but... I know what I see. So, that's why I'm here.
Do you ever hear voices or see things that other people around you do not seem to notice?
No. ...I don't. Nothing like that. I just see what they are actually doing to the house.
Are there any other situations or people in your life, outside of this house renovation, that you feel are involved in this plot against you?
No. ...Just the house. I don't see why anyone else would be involved. It's just the contractor and those neighbors. That's all.
